subject.title: feat(backup): add exclude patterns, --smart-exclude, and protected path guards [ai]

question: Should backup excludes be allowed to affect recovery archives implicitly via a state `.backupignore`, and may external assets bypass requested excludes with only a warning?
rationale: Backups are the recovery boundary, and the current PR can both omit files without an explicit flag and include external sensitive/large files despite requested excludes; automation cannot choose that product/security policy safely.

options.title: Require explicit and consistent excludes
options.body: Make `.backupignore` loading opt-in or tied to an explicit exclude mode, and apply patterns to every backed-up asset or fail non-interactive runs with an actionable error.

options.title: Accept warning-only external bypass
options.body: Land the current semantics only if maintainers intentionally accept that external workspaces/configs are archived in full despite matching exclude patterns.

options.title: Pause for narrower backup work
options.body: Keep the canonical feature issue open and ask for a smaller PR that lands one backup-exclude behavior at a time with proof.

recommendation.title: Require explicit and consistent excludes
recommendation.body: Make `.backupignore` loading opt-in or tied to an explicit exclude mode, and apply patterns to every backed-up asset or fail non-interactive runs with an actionable error.
